[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Technical Tutorial: Agile Manifesto and Principles"},{"order":2,"type":"subheading","text":"Introduction to Agile Methodologies"},{"order":3,"type":"paragraph","text":"The Agile Manifesto fundamentally transformed software engineering by prioritizing adaptability, human collaboration, and continuous delivery over rigid planning and documentation. Understanding the core values and 12 principles is essential for any modern technical team striving for high-velocity software development."},{"order":4,"type":"subheading","text":"The Four Core Values of the Agile Manifesto"},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Individuals and interactions over processes and tools: Valuing team communication and capability above rigid tooling and bureaucratic workflows."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Working software over comprehensive documentation: Prioritizing functional, tested code deployments over exhaustive specification manuals."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Customer collaboration over contract negotiation: Engaging stakeholders continuously rather than treating them as external entities bound by fixed requirements."},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Responding to change over following a plan: Embracing scope evolution and market shifts instead of adhering to a static, outdated project roadmap."},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"The 12 Agile Principles in Practice"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"The manifesto is underpinned by twelve operational principles designed to guide technical execution, team structures, and architecture decisions."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"1. Customer Satisfaction: Our highest priority is to satisfy the customer through early and continuous delivery of valuable software."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"2. Embrace Change: Welcome changing requirements, even late in development. Agile processes harness change for the customer's competitive advantage."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"3. Frequent Delivery: Deliver working software frequently, from a couple of weeks to a couple of months, with a preference to the shorter timescale."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Business people and developers must work together daily throughout the project lifecycle."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"5. Motivated Individuals: Build projects around motivated individuals. Give them the environment and support they need, and trust them to get the job done."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"6. Face-to-Face Communication: The most efficient and effective method of conveying information to and within a development team is face-to-face conversation."},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"7. Working Software as a Progress Metric: Working software is the primary measure of progress."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"8. Sustainable Development: Agile processes promote sustainable development. The sponsors, developers, and users should be able to maintain a constant pace indefinitely."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"9. Technical Excellence: Continuous attention to technical excellence and good design enhances agility."},{"order":20,"type":"bullet_point","text":"10. Simplicity: Simplicity--the art of maximizing the amount of work not done--is essential."},{"order":21,"type":"bullet_point","text":"11. Self-Organizing Teams: The best architectures, requirements, and designs emerge from self-organizing teams."},{"order":22,"type":"bullet_point","text":"12. Continuous Improvement: At regular intervals, the team reflects on how to become more effective, then tunes and adjusts its behavior accordingly."},{"order":23,"type":"subheading","text":"Implementing Agile in Technical Workflows"},{"order":24,"type":"paragraph","text":"To align CI/CD pipelines with Agile principles, automation is crucial. Below is an example configuration for automated testing ensuring continuous delivery of working software."},{"order":25,"type":"code","text":"name: Agile CI Pipeline
on: [push]
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: npm test -- --coverage"},{"order":26,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":27,"type":"paragraph","text":"By internalizing the Agile Manifesto and practicing its 12 principles, engineering teams can build resilient systems, reduce technical debt, and deliver exceptional value to stakeholders swiftly and sustainably."}]
